Dear Ms Whitfield,

Thank you for the discovery call of 6 October 2026. This letter proposes the Executive Briefing for Tamarack Instruments.

**Situation Summary**

Tamarack Instruments designs and manufactures laboratory measurement instruments and operates in the Netherlands, Germany and the United States. The Client has a customer service chatbot deployed on its support portal, an AI visual inspection pilot on the German production line and AI sales forecasting planned for next year. Your stated objective is: "I want governance in place before visual inspection goes into production in Q2 2027." The Client has named the EU AI Act and GDPR as regulatory drivers and intends to begin ISO/IEC 42001 work next year, with the start date not yet fixed. Customer data must stay in the EU, and the German works council is consulted before anything touches production staff.

**What the Briefing Covers for the Client**

The Briefing maps the EU AI Act and GDPR to each of the three use cases. This includes transparency expectations for the chatbot, the risk classification question for visual inspection and data protection expectations under the EU data residency requirement. All regulatory points are framed as expectations to verify with counsel and are not legal advice. United States requirements are not among the Client's stated drivers. They appear only as a general landscape item.

We then discuss readiness at the Client's current piloting maturity. We introduce a governance operating model using the GRC Workbook (https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook) and Slow AI Kitchen (https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen), with board-layer considerations drawn from AI Governance for Boards (https://github.com/rolldabones/ai-governance-for-boards). The session closes on implementation priorities sequenced toward Q2 2027, including where works council consultation sits in that sequence. Throughout, we apply three principles: Slow AI, Informed Intent and Final Liability rests with the Human.

**Logistics and Price**

The Executive Briefing is a two-hour live virtual session priced at US$3,000. It is designed for executive leadership and board-level attendees. The audience roles you identified are General Counsel, CISO, Head of Quality, Head of Data, German plant manager and two internal auditors. The fee sits within the budget of up to US$80,000 stated as approved for this fiscal year.

**What the Client Receives Afterward**

After the session, the Client receives a written follow-up memo. It summarizes the decisions surfaced, our readiness observations and three prioritized recommendations, each mapped to a next program option. The Briefing can inform preparation for ISO/IEC 42001. It does not promise certification, audit outcomes or regulatory approval.

**Next Step**

Please confirm a preferred session date and the final attendee list. We will then send the timed agenda for your review.

Kind regards,

[Consultant Name]
Senior AI Governance Consultant, AI Governance Academy

Human-made, for Easy Work, Simply Done.
